messages:
tess-sales: Customer (FinCore) approved POC traffic. Steady ~180 RPS, short spikes to ~700 RPS for ~20-45s, ~3x/day. Need reserve+burst proposal + security questionnaire answers by EOD.
omar-solutions: Are spikes composed of many parallel short chat turns or fewer long prompts? This affects batching and KV cache.
li-sre: They reported ~80% chat-like (30-60 tokens) and ~20% long completions (up to 1600 tokens). Tail latency is the main SLA concern.
jin-runtime: Quick calc: steady: 180*45 toks ~= 8.1k toks/s. Peak 700 -> ~31.5k toks/s. Ballpark config: reserve 4 GPUs baseline, hot burst pool 4 GPUs, autoscale up to 16 replicas. Quantized fallback saves ~30-40% GPU during bursts.
mira-security: Security checklist notes: FinCore requires VPC-only control plane, customer-managed KMS (CMEK), SOC2 + PCI scoping notes. Need exact log retention and data-delete window to answer fully.
tess-sales: Pricing: they want two options: conservative (lower risk) and cost-optimized. Include monthly numbers + burst credit estimate. Ops buffer as standard.
jin-runtime: Draft autoscale snippet:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 4
  target_rps_per_replica: 50
  max_replicas: 16
  burst_pool_gpus: 4
  quantized_fallback: true
  cooldown_seconds: 30
```
Maps to reserve 4 GPUs + 4 hot-burst GPUs; can reduce reserve to 2 for cost-optimized option with larger burst reliance.
ops-bot: Cost sim complete: conservative = $81,200/mo (4 reserved + 4 burst credits + ops buffer). cost-optimized = $50,700/mo (2 reserved + bigger burst + quantized fallback). Link: https://ops.redwood.example/sim/1769456789
li-sre: Ops notes: prewarm KV cache for common prefixes 30s before expected spikes. Add synthetic traffic probe to verify warm pools. Canary fallback to smaller model if p99 > 1.2s.
omar-solutions: I'll draft proposal language for both options. @jin-runtime please run per-model p99 bench and post numbers (including quantized model perf) by 15:30 UTC.
mira-security: I will draft questionnaire responses for KMS, VPC-only, and data retention. Need a short statement about logs: default retention 90 days, can be adjusted. Will return by 16:00 UTC.
tess-sales: Great — if perf numbers + security answers arrive by 16:00 I can send the proposal and aim to close this week. Thanks everyone :rocket:
